$avvy
is a 2021 American
documentary film
directed by Robin Hauser, written by Jessica Floum. It follows the historical, cultural, and societal norms around women and money. Haley Sacks, Carrie Schwab,
Farnoosh Torabi
, and
Sallie Krawcheck
appear in the film.
[
2
]
The film had its world premiere at the
Santa Barbara International Film Festival
on April 1, 2021.
